descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · 已排除（票还在 in progress / ready for pr（Quinn 10-14：不计入 bug 数））· 原 P1

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29

思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S29 「保留窗口是配置值，不是写死的」 Retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T7 Every 3.6 retention window is a configuration value, not hard-coded, so it can be lengthened under a hospital affiliation without a code change.（UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The read-only worktree of main (round-companion-wt-qa) and the 3.6 window list

When For each 3.6 window, find where its value comes from. Hospital: pre-round, Important Points, encounter, note, previous note, vitals/labs/imaging, medication rows, open tasks, completed tasks. Nursing Home: pre-round, encounter, note, last two visits

Then Every window is read from a configuration value (deployment setting or a settings row), so it can be lengthened without a code change

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 ('All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded') + TFA-94699 AC 7. A window defined only as a code constant is a Fail of T7; main defines HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION as consts, so a Fail is expected. Optional later, once a configuration path exists: an api-lane check that sets the pre-round window to 24 h on the local stack through that path and confir …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S29 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

所有保留期窗口都写死在代码里，改任何一个都要发版；医院未完成任务根本没有清理窗口。

Every retention window is a code constant, so none can be changed without a code release, and Hospital open tasks have no window at all.

依据：allure b9a384d8, code review: HOSPITAL_RETENTION (lifecycle.ts:8-28) and SNF_RETENTION (30-38) are as-const objects, with no environment or settings read. Already recorded as known:windows-consts and as OAT-04 K9 (TFA-94699 AC 7), K2 (open tasks) and K7 (NH keeps 3 visits). Whether a named constant counts as configuration is TC-12 Q12 / OAT-04 Q11.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S29

Retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status known-gap → 已知缺口（已知缺口）。

Detail:

This fails. Every 3.6 retention window the code applies is hard-coded in two `as const` objects in apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts: HOSPITAL_RETENTION (lines 8–28) and SNF_RETENTION (lines 30–38). No window reads an environment variable, a deployment setting or a settings row. A grep of convex/ for retention, window or TTL environment reads found none. The lifecycle functions use the constants directly. So changing any window, for example for a hospital affiliation, needs a code change and a redeploy. This is the recorded gap known:windows-consts.

Hospital windows:
- Pre-round: 12 h (L9, used L122)
- Important Points: 18 h (L10, used L138)
- Encounter: 18 h (L11, used L152); the archived encounter is kept 48 h (L23, used L171)
- Note: 18 h (L12, used L182)
- Previous note: 36 h (L22, used L195)
- Vitals/labs/imaging: 36 h (objectiveData, L27, used L233/239/245)
- Medication rows: 36 h (L21, used L276)
- Completed tasks: 16 h (doneTask, L13, used L223)
- Open tasks: no window exists in lifecycle.ts at all. The task filter only removes done tasks (L221–223), and the 36 h patient window mentioned in the comments is not enforced anywhere I found.

Nursing Home windows:
- Pre-round: 12 h (L31, used L304)
- Encounter: 12 h (L32, used L318)
- Note: 18 h (L33, used L348)
- Last visits: kept as counts, not hours. Archived transcripts keep 3 (transcriptVisits, L35, used L336–337), previous notes keep 3 (L36, used L360), medication rows keep 3 visits (L37, used L394–395). The scenario says "last two visits"; the code keeps 3.
- Completed tasks: 16 h (L34, used L381)

The open-task and visit-count points are about window values. Other scenarios own those; they don't change this verdict.

确认的已知缺口（knownGapsConfirmed）：

  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:8: The Hospital windows are a code constant object, not a configuration value.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:9: Hospital pre-round 12 h, Important Points 18 h, encounter 18 h, note 18 h, completed tasks 16 h are literals.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:21: Hospital medication 36 h, previous note 36 h, encounter archive 48 h are literals.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:27: Hospital vitals/labs/imaging window 36 h is a literal.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:30: The Nursing Home windows are a code constant object: pre-round 12 h, encounter 12 h, note 18 h, done task 16 h, 3 transcripts, 3 notes, 3 medication visits.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:122: The constants are used directly when deciding expiry (for example Hospital pre-round); no setting is read.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:336: Nursing Home transcript visit count is used directly from the constant.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:21: The medication, previous-note and objective-data (vitals/labs/imaging) windows are literal 36h constants.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:27: The vitals/labs/imaging window is the constant objectiveData of 36h.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:122: The Hospital pre-round clear reads the const directly, not a setting.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:336: The Nursing Home visit history is trimmed by the const transcriptVisits (3), not by a configured value.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:108: The patch function takes only the record and now; no settings or configuration value is passed in.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Open tasks have no retention window in lifecycle.ts, and the 36 h patient window mentioned in the comments was not found anywhere. Confirm whether some other mechanism is meant to apply a window to open tasks.
  • The scenario lists Nursing Home 'last two visits', but the code keeps 3 transcripts, 3 previous notes and 3 medication visits. Confirm the intended count (this belongs to a different scenario than configurability).
  • The 3.6 list names 'last two visits' for the Nursing Home, but the code keeps 3 archived visits, 3 previous notes and 3 visits of medication history (SNF_RETENTION lines 35-37). This may differ from 3.6; it is outside T7 but worth confirming.
  • The 3.6 list names a Hospital open-task window, but the lifecycle code has no open-task expiry: only done tasks are removed. Confirm whether open tasks are meant to leave with a patient-level window.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • The optional api-lane check (set pre-round to 24 h through a configuration path and confirm the text survives the 13 h point) cannot run, because no configuration path exists.
  • The optional api-lane check (set the pre-round window to 24h through a configuration path and confirm the pre-round text survives the 13h point) cannot run until a configuration path exists.

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：A hospital that needs longer retention (for example pre-round text kept 24 h instead of 12 h) cannot get it from an admin setting. An engineer has to change the code and redeploy, and until then pre-round text and other content is cleared on the fixed hard-coded schedule. / A hospital that needs longer retention, for example keeping pre-round text past 12h under a hospital affiliation, cannot get it without a code change and a new deployment. Every physician gets the same fixed clear times.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
